integrity: The inclusive threshold lambda >= kappa is proved by a one-state witness; the negative direction for lambda < kappa follows from the size restriction and successor-cardinal boundary.
The ZFC claim follows from the cited pointwise transfer lemma, not from finite experimentation.
The comparison with the rank cut is a threshold comparison under GCH: lambda > kappa there, versus lambda >= kappa for the size cut.
limitations: Assumes a transitive set model of ZFC+GCH and one infinite size-cut threshold.
Classifies intermediate existence for all infinite-cardinal intervals in one size-cut domain; it is not a classification of all filtrations.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.

title: A size cut shifts the crisp-intermediate threshold to kappa
